title: Hubble Finds an Hourglass Nebula around a Dying Star
author: NASA/JPL-Caltech/ESA, the Hubble Heritage Team STScI/AURA
description: This Hubble telescope snapshot of MyCn18, a young planetary nebula, reveals that the object has an hourglass shape with an intricate pattern of etchings in its walls. A planetary nebula is the glowing relic of a dying, Sun-like star.
